newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine bourse to regulate backdoor listings.
newsitem.headline: Philippine bourse to regulate backdoor listings.

text.p: Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) chairman Wilson Sy said on Monday he had asked the bourse to draft regulations protecting minor shareholders in case of a backdoor listing.
Several big companies have bought majority stakes in dormant and cheap listed companies in order to skirt the rigid listing requirements of the bourse.
Sy told reporters that those buying in during the takeover should tender the same terms to minority shareholders instead of only seeking a majority stake.

"There is again a big potential for backdoor listing especially now that mining and oil companies are in the doldrums. There should be some sort of regulation to protect minority shareholders," Sy said.
